name: runtime
description: Authenticated local process supervisor for Browser and Scheduler daemons with bounded startup, health checks, restart limits, non-secret state, logs, and foreground command cleanup

capabilities.name: runtime.supervise
capabilities.description: Start, monitor, restart, and stop authenticated local Agent Forge services

capabilities.name: runtime.run
capabilities.description: Run a foreground command while supervising selected services and clean up owned processes on exit

capabilities.name: runtime.health
capabilities.description: Report authenticated service health, port state, PID ownership, and token fingerprints without exposing bearer tokens

credentials.description: Optional explicit Browser bearer token; generated locally otherwise
Optional explicit Scheduler bearer token; generated locally otherwise

health_checks.description: Verify the Supervisor module and its standard-library process boundaries import; live daemon readiness is reported separately by the status command
